v7GateRecommendations: Add error envelope format to GS document: document both errors.body[] (generic) and resource-scoped errors.field[] (Conduit spec requirement). Enforce via Hurl gate at generation time.
Add nullable field coercion rule: empty string inputs for nullable fields must be stored as NULL. Enforce via Hurl auth test.

rx_inferred.conclusion: Both root causes (RC1 bio coercion, RC2 error envelope scoping) are specification gaps. RC2 is present in both AX v6 and RX specs. The Hurl suite is the first tool that exposed this because it tests the full HTTP contract, not just unit behavior. This is the value of adding Hurl as a quality gate.
rx_inferred.target: RX (inferred from spec inspection — generated code not on disk)
rx_inferred.finding: RX spec conduit-gs.md §3.4 explicitly specifies errors.body[] as the error envelope format. RX-generated code would produce the same error structure as treatment-v6 and would fail the same Hurl tests for the same reason. The gap is in the specification, not the implementation. Running Hurl against a re-generated RX instance is deferred: the spec inspection closes the inference gap.

v6.hurlSuite: gothinkster/realworld specs/api/hurl (13 files, official Conduit contract suite)
v6.targetDescription: AX treatment-v6: GS-guided implementation, 13/14 rubric score, 0 tsc errors, 0 ESLint errors

errors_profiles.rootCause: Error envelope scoping: profile not-found under errors.body[]; spec expects errors.profile['not found']

errors_auth.rootCause: Error envelope scoping: validation errors under errors.body[]; spec expects errors.username[], errors.email[], etc.

errors_articles.rootCause: Error envelope scoping: article errors under errors.body[]; spec expects errors.article[]

errors_authorization.rootCause: Error envelope scoping: authorization errors under errors.body[]; spec expects errors.article['forbidden']

articles.rootCause: Error envelope scoping: articles endpoint returns errors.body[] for not-found; spec expects errors.article[]

auth.rootCause: Bio null coercion: PUT /api/user with bio=empty-string returns bio='' instead of bio=null. Spec expects null for empty bio.

errors_comments.rootCause: Error envelope scoping: comment errors under errors.body[]; spec expects errors.comment[]

rootCauses.gsGap: Specification does not document the empty-string-to-null coercion rule for nullable fields. A quality gate on Bounded (named constants + documented coercion rules) would have caught this.
rootCauses.detail: PUT /api/user with bio='' (empty string) returns bio='' instead of bio=null. The Conduit spec treats empty bio as null. One test fails.

rootCauses.gsGap: Specification does not include the Conduit error envelope format as an explicit contract. A Hurl gate on the API contract would have caught this at generation time.
rootCauses.detail: All error responses use errors.body[] (generic). The Conduit spec expects resource-scoped keys: errors.username[], errors.article[], errors.profile[], errors.comment[]. The server returns the correct error messages but under the wrong key.

v6.finding: Happy-path endpoints: 6/7 pass (tags, profiles, comments, favorites, feed, pagination). All error-handling contract tests fail due to a single root cause: non-resource-scoped error envelopes. Both root causes are specification gaps, not logic errors — the server returns correct data under wrong keys. These are addressable in a v7 GS document update.
